findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_msg91_docs, get_msg91_api_docs, call_any_read_api_of_msg91, call_any_api_of_msg91 · Private data: get_msg91_api_docs, call_any_read_api_of_msg91, call_any_api_of_msg91 · Public sink: call_any_read_api_of_msg91, call_any_api_of_msg91 · Destructive: call_any_read_api_of_msg91, call_any_api_of_msg91.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_msg91_docs, get_msg91_api_docs, call_any_read_api_of_msg91, call_any_api_of_msg91 · Private data: get_msg91_api_docs, call_any_read_api_of_msg91, call_any_api_of_msg91 · Public sink: call_any_read_api_of_msg91, call_any_api_of_msg91 · Destructive: call_any_read_api_of_msg91, call_any_api_of_msg91

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
